metadata.name: CCG Challenges
metadata.description: [h1]CCG Challenge Collection[/h1] [b]This mod adds 8 unique & fun custom challenges to The Binding of Isaac: Repentance![/b] As we all know, The Binding of Isaac boasts unmatched gameplay variety. Over 700 different collectibles create infinite build combinations, and countless unique runs always bring brand-new surprises. What’s more, Isaac’s official modding API allows creators to expand the game with custom code, opening up a whole new realm of gameplay possibilities! Have you ever experienced the world through the Shopkeeper’s eyes? Have you seen Gello launching Lilith as a projectile? Could you take down The Lamb if all your stats are locked from increasing? Would you regain your drive to conquer an ultra-hard variant of Greed Mode? Can you complete runs smoothly when Tainted Forgotten is heavily restricted, and Tainted Magdalene loses all red hearts? I developed 8 entirely unique custom challenges from scratch via custom code, delivering gameplay experiences vastly different from vanilla Isaac. Hope you all enjoy this mod! [i]More updates are on the way...[/i] [h2]Mod Collection Notes[/h2] [list] [*][b]About the theme[/b] This pack has no unified central theme. Every challenge was built around a random fun concept I came up with and fully implemented through code. "CCG" stands for my personal initials — the only common trait all challenges share is that I created every single one. [*][b]Difficulty design[/b] The Binding of Isaac is a single-player game, and player skill levels vary widely. When designing these challenges, I prioritized fun over perfectly balanced difficulty. Feel free to tweak the difficulty mid-run using the debug console if you find any challenge too tough — even I cannot beat every challenge myself. If you have the Mod Config Menu mod installed: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2494192799]Steam Workshop - Mod Config Menu[/url], this mod supports full parameter adjustment for multiple challenges. [*][b]Testing & bug reports[/b] This mod is a solo personal project, so I did not have enough time to test every edge case thoroughly. If you encounter any bugs, you can leave a comment on this workshop page or submit an issue on my GitHub repository. I appreciate your patience and understanding. For the most stable gameplay experience, I recommend playing on Windows with The Binding of Isaac: Repentance. [/list]
